title: 第42章 杀戮第41章 冷漠指责
lines: 坚硬无比的火鸦羽翼被白枫死死攥在掌心，任凭火鸦少主催动全身鸦火焚烧，烈焰焚身，却连白枫一层皮肉都无法灼伤。
下一秒，咔嚓一声刺耳的骨裂巨响炸开！
火鸦少主那一对纵横战场、斩过圣人的本命神翼，竟然被白枫硬生生徒手掰断！
剧痛席卷神魂，火鸦少主浑身抽搐，鲜血顺着羽根疯狂滴落，他瞳孔剧烈震颤，满脸极致的惊恐，失声疯狂大吼：
“不对！
你绝对不是神游境！
你的气息明明禁锢在神游巅峰，为什么肉身与力量恐怖到这种地步！”
白枫眉眼无波，神色淡得像一片寒潭寒冰，自始至终一言不发，无半分情绪起伏。
他掌心再度发力，不给对方任何喘息之机，双手分别扣住两侧残存羽翼，猛地再度向内撕扯！
又是两声撕心裂肺的筋骨撕裂声响起，火鸦少主双肩彻底血肉模糊，双翼彻底被连根拔起，漫天赤红火羽漫天纷飞。
此刻的火鸦少主彻底丧失全部战力，浑身剧痛难忍，悬浮在虚空之中，连站立都做不到。
他可是实打实的归墟巅峰天骄，年少成名，曾经正面鏖战圣人强者并且取胜，一身战力冠绝同辈。
可今天，他在一个气息只有神游巅峰的少年面前，毫无还手之力，心底升起深入骨髓的恐惧。
“不公平！
这不公平！”
火鸦少主双目赤红，彻底癫狂，歇斯底里嘶吼，声音响彻整片崩塌秘境，引来全场所有人侧目，“我是火鸦少主，我是天之骄子！
你一个低境界修士，凭什么碾压我！”
没有回应，没有动容，白枫掌心骤然收紧。
砰！
一声闷响，火鸦少主身躯直接被蛮力撕裂，鲜血与火羽漫天飘散，堂堂火鸦少主，当场陨落，尸骨无存。
“少主！”
下方正在厮杀的十余名火鸦族人瞬间心神俱裂，悲愤欲绝。
此刻战场之中，人族天骄已经倒下三人，鲜血染红衣衫，只剩下赵木带着另外两人苦苦支撑，灵力枯竭，伤痕遍体，落败只是早晚之事。
可当他们亲眼看见白枫徒手撕碎火鸦少主的一幕，全场瞬间死寂。
赵木浑身僵在原地，手中长剑哐当落地，喉咙干涩发疼，大脑一片空白。
她这一刻终于彻底明白，为何副城主苏衍再三叮嘱所有人，必须听从白枫号令，必须敬畏这名神游巅峰修士。
哪里是什么普通神游修士，这分明是一尊隐藏锋芒的绝世怪物！
能够越阶碾压斩杀曾经战胜圣人的火鸦少主，对方在白枫手里，如同蝼蚁玩偶，任由揉捏撕扯。
回想之前他们的猜忌、谩骂、冷眼旁观，甚至还有人帮外敌逼迫白枫接受搜魂之术，赵木脸颊发烫，满心羞愧与后怕，他们这群眼高于顶的人族天骄，从头到尾，都只是一群无知可笑的跳梁小丑。
“为少主报仇，杀了他！”
剩余所有火鸦族人彻底红眼，放弃围杀人族天骄，全员裹挟焚天鸦火，不顾一切朝着白枫冲杀而来，杀意滔天。
十余道归墟巅峰气息合围而来，杀意汹汹，白枫眸光依旧平静无澜，指尖轻弹，腰间碧玉长剑无声出鞘。
没有惊天动地的异象，没有浩荡灵力爆发，仅仅简简单单一道平直剑影。
剑光一闪，转瞬即逝。
冲来的所有火鸦族人，甚至来不及发出一声惨叫，身躯尽数碎裂，全员当场被一剑斩灭，漫天火羽纷纷扬扬飘落而下，再无半点生机。
尘埃落定。
赵木和余下两名人族天骄呆呆站在原地，浑身发抖，大气都不敢喘，看向半空白衣少年的目光，只剩下极致的恐惧与敬畏。
赵木嘴唇不停哆嗦，低下头，声音颤抖又卑微，满心悔恨：
“白……白枫，不，白前辈……我等知错了……”
content_en:
The extremely hard fire crow wings were tightly held in Bai Feng's palm. No matter how much the young master of the fire crow activated the crow fire all over his body, the flames burned his body, but not even a layer of Bai Feng's flesh could be burned.
The next second, there was a loud crack and a loud cracking sound of bones!
The pair of young master Huo Yao's divine wings that crossed the battlefield and killed saints were actually broken off by Bai Feng with his bare hands!
Severe pain swept through his soul. The young master of Fire Crow twitched all over, and blood dripped crazily from his feathers. His pupils trembled violently, his face was filled with extreme panic, and he yelled wildly:
"No!
You are definitely not in the Immortal Ascension Realm!
Your aura is obviously imprisoned at the peak of the divine movement, why are your body and strength so terrifying? "
Bai Feng's eyebrows were as calm as a cold pond, and he didn't say a word from beginning to end, showing no emotion.
He exerted force with his palms again, not giving the opponent any chance to breathe. He clasped the remaining wings on both sides with both hands and violently tore them inward again!
There were two more heartbreaking sounds of muscle and bone tearing, and the Fire Crow Young Master's shoulders were completely bloody and bloody, his wings were completely uprooted, and red fire feathers were flying all over the sky.
At this moment, the young master of the fire crow has completely lost all his combat power, and is in unbearable pain all over his body. He is suspended in the void and cannot even stand up.
He is truly the top talent of Guixu. He became famous at a young age. He once faced off against a strong saint and won, and his combat prowess was the best among his peers.
But today, in front of a young man whose aura was at the peak of his divine movement, he was powerless to fight back, and a bone-deep fear arose in his heart.
"Unfair!
This is not fair! "
Young Master Fire Crow's eyes were red, he was completely crazy, and he screamed hysterically. His voice resounded throughout the collapsed secret realm, attracting the attention of everyone in the audience, "I am Young Master Fire Crow, and I am the proud son of heaven!"
You, a low-level monk, why should you crush me? "
There was no response, no expression, and Bai Feng's palms suddenly tightened.
Bang!
With a muffled sound, the young master of Fire Crow's body was directly torn apart by brute force. Blood and fire feathers scattered all over the sky. The dignified young master of Fire Crow fell on the spot, with no bones left.
"Young Master!"
The dozen or so Fire Crow tribesmen who were fighting below were instantly shattered and filled with grief and anger.
At this moment in the battlefield, three of the human race's geniuses have fallen, their clothes stained red with blood. Only Zhao Mu and the other two are left struggling to support themselves. Their spiritual power is exhausted and their bodies are covered with scars. It is only a matter of time before they are defeated.
But when they saw with their own eyes the scene of Bai Feng tearing the Fire Crow Young Master to pieces with his bare hands, the whole place fell silent for an instant.
Zhao Mu froze on the spot, the sword in his hand clattered to the ground, his throat was dry and sore, and his mind went blank.
At this moment, she finally fully understood why the deputy city lord Su Yan repeatedly told everyone to obey Bai Feng's orders and to respect this peak fugue cultivator.
Where is the ordinary wandering monk? This is clearly a peerless monster with hidden edge!
He was able to transcend the ranks and crush and kill the Fire Crow Young Master who once defeated the Saint. In Bai Feng's hands, the opponent was like an ant doll, allowing him to be kneaded and torn apart.
Recalling their previous suspicions, abuses, cold looks, and even the fact that some people helped foreign enemies force Bai Feng to accept the soul-searching technique, Zhao Mu's cheeks were hot, and he was filled with shame and fear. They, the talented people of the human race who have eyes above their heads, were just a bunch of ignorant and ridiculous clowns from the beginning to the end.
"Avenge the young master and kill him!"
All the remaining members of the Fire Crow tribe were completely red-eyed and gave up the siege of the genius of the killing tribe. They all gathered around the Burning Crow Fire and rushed towards Bai Feng at all costs with overwhelming murderous intent.
More than ten Guixu peak auras surrounded him, with fierce murderous intent. Bai Feng's eyes remained calm and calm. With a flick of his fingertips, the jade sword at his waist was unsheathed silently.
There was no earth-shattering vision, no mighty spiritual power explosion, just a simple straight sword shadow.
The sword light flashed and disappeared in an instant.
All the Fire Crow clan members who rushed towards them didn't even have time to let out a scream. Their bodies were all broken into pieces. They were all killed with a sword on the spot. Fire feathers filled the sky and fell down, leaving no trace of life left.
The dust has settled.
Zhao Mu and the remaining two human geniuses stood there blankly, trembling all over, not daring to breathe. They looked at the boy in half-blank clothes with only extreme fear and awe.
Zhao Mu's lips kept trembling, he lowered his head, his voice was trembling and humble, full of regret:
"Bai...Bai Feng, no, Senior Bai...I know I was wrong..."
